[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] '''Ulm Brashere''' was an individual who represented the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the last century of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]], [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]]&mdash;an executive of the company [[Quintad Orbital Manufacturing]]&mdash;persuaded Brashere to ask [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Thoris Darus]] to appoint Tarkin as the Seswenna [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor-General]]. In [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]], Brashere was replaced in the Senate by Tarkin.
